sampling_protocol.weighting: Each training probe has equal total weight; its interior states have equal weight.
sampling_protocol.A_target: Exact vendor acceleration at the same interior states used by B.
sampling_protocol.B_target: Velocity difference recomputed exclusively from train_probes r_obs/v_obs/times.
sampling_protocol.heldout_policy: Score only after training selection. Never search, fit, tune or select using heldout.
sampling_protocol.budget_note: 32 probes per world intentionally exceeds one Agent energy budget; this is an offline capability diagnostic.

datasets.feature_property_note: Both mass and charge vary in every world. For single-center public worlds, charge maps to source p1 and mass to probe p2; elsewhere mass is passed to the vendor and charge is an inert diagnostic nuisance feature. This is offline identifiability data, not the Agent allowed-property surface.
